items.title: Define a fail-closed cross-process capacity delegation contract
items.context: Reuse the B-6693 workspace capacity holder identity. Delegation must bind workspace, live holder/acquisition token, and parent process lineage; malformed, stale, foreign-workspace, or replayed delegation must not bypass capacity.
items.userSees: Official DONE validation can launch the root suite without self-deadlocking, while unrelated root suites still serialize.
excludes: Coordinating arbitrary individual test scripts that do not enter the root runner

items.title: Make the root full-suite entry acquire capacity or consume only a valid delegation
items.context: The root runner is the single common hook for npm test. A bare invocation must wait for capacity with existing structured diagnostics; an official descendant consumes a verified delegation and never acquires or releases the parent ticket.
items.userSees: Running npm test directly no longer races an official validation in the same workspace.
excludes: Changing the canonical full-suite member list

items.title: Prove serialization, delegation cleanup, and no semantic drift
items.context: Add real child-process regressions for bare-versus-official serialization, valid delegated child completion, invalid and stale token rejection, parent failure cleanup, maxConcurrency=1, and unchanged terminal summary/exit classification.
items.userSees: The mechanism fails closed and remains recoverable after crashes, timeout, or malformed delegation.
excludes: Evidence based only on mocks or a single event loop

items.title: Document the exact coordinated and excluded entrypoints
items.context: State that official validate/done-required and root npm test share capacity; arbitrary individual npm run test:* commands remain outside scope. Document cross-process delegation and operational diagnostics without promising global machine-wide scheduling.
items.userSees: Operators can tell which commands are serialized and why a run is waiting.
